title: Activation cohorts & compatibility gates for Private Instances — Q2 rollout
creator: Priya Shah
description: Goal: Define and execute a guided activation program for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers that minimizes regressions, shortens time-to-first-success, and reduces ops load during initial waves. Deliverables include a 3‑cohort activation matrix, automated compatibility checks (pre-install and runtime), a compatibility gate checklist for engineering signoff, and a scripted onboarding runbook for CSMs and Solutions Engineers.
background: Customers report variable integration effort across OS, distro, and private networking configurations — resulting in longer onboarding times for non-standard setups.

We need a reproducible way to admit new Private instances into production with a predictable risk profile and an easy escalation path. Current wave-based plans focus on capacity; this initiative focuses on activation readiness and technical compatibility gating.
acceptance_criteria: Define three customer activation cohorts (Green/Amber/Red) with objective compatibility scoring criteria.
Deliver an automated preflight compatibility tool (CLI/checker) that returns a pass/fail plus remediation hints for 90% of supported configurations.
Create an engineering compatibility gate checklist with explicit rollback triggers and owner signoff steps.
Produce a CSM/SE onboarding playbook and runbook with template emails, checklist, and escalation contacts.
Run a pilot activation with 2 internal customers (Green and Amber) and capture metrics and runbook edits.
No Sev1/Sev2 during pilot activation window attributable to compatibility regressions (baseline: prior activations had 1 Sev2 per 4 activations).

risks: Preflight checker may produce false positives for custom network topologies, leading to unnecessary escalations
Engineering bandwidth conflicts with Dedicated capacity autoscaling work during April
Customer legal/ops constraints may delay pilot onboarding for Amber/Red cohorts
Incomplete telemetry on private instances could mask regressions until after activation
success_metrics: Median days-to-first-success drops from 21 -> 10 for Green cohort in pilot
Pilot activation rate: 2 pilots completed with <1 post-activation P1/P2 attributable to compatibility
Preflight checker true-positive rate >= 88% on internal compatibility testbed
CSAT for onboarding > 9/10 for pilot customers
Onboarding ops effort reduction: average SE hours per activation drops by 40%
notes: Cohort scoring will weight kernel version, container runtime, private network topology, outbound egress rules, and KMS availability.
Consider adding a lightweight agent for runtime health checks post-activation if telemetry gaps persist.
We will use feature flags to gate the compatibility-checker integration into the installer pipeline.
Engage Legal early for data localization questions raised by pilot Red cohort customer.
